'''Deputy's Revolver''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. This card is earned by becoming the [[Deputy of Arkham]].

==Card info==
'''Type''': Physical Weapon

'''Bonus''': +3 [[Combat check]]

Deputy's Revolver cannot be lost or stolen unless you choose to allow it.

'''Hands''': 1
